control_semantics.ungated: preserve q*s_c and disable only the Router gate
control_semantics.wrong_layer: preserve the SAME absolute perturbation norm q*s_c; do NOT renormalize by the wrong layer's activation norm, which would change layer and budget simultaneously

explicit_statements: equal hidden-state norm does not imply equal score-space effect
functional-effect differences are part of the estimator comparison and are not normalized away
no DEV outcome was used to define s_c, rho_ref or the grid
q=1 is a scale unit, not a previously validated operating dose
Stage 2A will select the smallest behaviorally admissible nonzero q
the grid must not be extended after observing DEV results
matched_budget_arms: frozen L26 DiffMean comparator injected at L21
purpose: Prospectively define a Qwen3-specific activation-scale dose unit. This does not recover a historical dose; no unique Qwen3 rho_ref ever existed.

rho_ref.semantics: dimensionless activation-scale unit, NOT a recovered historical operating dose

scale_statistic.formula: s_c = median_x || h_L21(x) ||_2 over the scaling population
scale_statistic.site: model.model.layers[L].mlp forward output, after MLP internals and before decoder residual addition

scaling_population.definition: all V2 TRAIN rows for which the frozen channel-c Router gate is active
scaling_population.gate: baseline prediction == channel source AND committed Router predict_proba[:,1] >= committed selected tau
scaling_population.router_reconstruction_validated: recomputed DEV routed counts reproduce all 15 committed tau-grid cells exactly across the three channels
